text: Packs only has passport and us-entry rules. Search the whole repo (excluding node_modules/.git) for 'radar' with a timeout, limited to likely source dirs.
command: cd /work && timeout 20 grep -rIil -e radar --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git apps domains functions platform tests tools docs knowledge-base tenants rules 2>/dev/null | head -30
